# Draft:Linda Zwartbol

Linda Zwartbol (1993 in Sankt Vith, Belgium) is a Belgian politician of the SP Ostbelgien (Socialist and Social Democratic Party of the German-speaking Community). Since 2023, she has served as the president of the SP Ostbelgien.
Life and Career
After training in media design, Zwartbol initially worked in that field before becoming a journalist and radio presenter. From 2019 to 2024, she worked as a public relations officer in the cabinet of the then Deputy Minister-President of the German-speaking Community, Antonios Antoniadis.
In February 2023, she was elected president of SP Ostbelgien, becoming the first woman to hold this position. In November 2024, she was re-elected with 80 percent of the vote, defeating a challenger. Since 2024, she has also been the managing director and parliamentary secretary of the SP parliamentary group in the Parliament of the German-speaking Community (PDG).
In the federal parliamentary elections on 9 June 2024, Linda Zwartbol ran as the highest-ranking German-speaking candidate on the Parti Socialiste (PS) list in the Liège constituency. Since December 2024, she has also been a member of the municipal council of the town of Sankt Vith.
Personal Life
As the daughter of a single mother, Zwartbol is particularly committed to social justice, equal opportunities, and the strengthening of women's rights.
Political Mandates
* Since 2023 – President of SP Ostbelgien
* Since 2024 – Member of the municipal council of Sankt Vith
